offering_description.value: Delivers electricity, natural gas and steam through regulated networks to homes and businesses in New York City and Westchester County, with rates set by state regulators. Customers are billed for metered energy use, and the company maintains and upgrades its networks.

primary_services.value: electric and gas distribution; steam distribution; emergency response; network maintenance

items.detail: commercial and industrial customers, building owners, real estate developers
city and state government agencies, public institutions

end_markets.value: real estate; commercial offices; manufacturing; public sector; residential housing

items.detail: metered charges for electricity, gas and steam delivered to customers
connection, meter and other utility service charges
owns and runs energy networks, takes in power and gas supplied by generators and pipelines, sells delivered energy to local customers

geography_served.detail: New York City and Westchester County, New York

specialization.detail: electricity, natural gas and steam delivery sharing networks, customers and billing

items.detail: utility bills and service agreements sent directly to customers
online account management and bill payment for customers

regulatory_exposure.detail: high: utility rates and operations regulated by New York State Public Service Commission and federal energy regulators

offering_description.value: Develops, owns and operates renewable energy projects such as solar and battery storage, selling power and energy services under long-term contracts to commercial, industrial and government customers across several US states.

primary_products.value: solar power; battery storage; renewable energy certificates

primary_services.value: project development; operations and maintenance; energy management

items.detail: commercial and industrial power buyers, utilities, project investors

end_markets.value: power generation; commercial real estate; utilities; public sector

items.detail: payments for electricity generated and delivered under power purchase contracts
development and construction fees for energy projects
owns and runs solar and storage assets, sells power output to offtakers
operates and maintains projects for third-party owners and customers

geography_served.detail: projects in multiple US states, including New York and other Northeast and Southern states

specialization.detail: solar generation, battery storage and related energy services sharing customers and project development

items.detail: long-term contracts negotiated directly with commercial, industrial and government buyers
joint ventures and partners that co-develop projects
